{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Doc changes are limited to a release note and a one-line update in REST-interface.md accompanying the code changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation updates are secondary to the txindex and RPC functional changes."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes src/index/txindex.cpp, src/index/txindex.h, and introduces tx_lookup_result.h to allow txindex to operate under block pruning.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "user request",
      "rationale": "Resolves four long-standing user feature requests dating back to 2017 (#10609, #12651, #16182, #35240) by allowing -txindex to run on pruned nodes. Reviewers noted this is a major improvement that significantly expands the capability of pruned nodes."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Updates getrawtransaction, gettxoutproof, and REST endpoints to distinguish pruned transactions from missing transactions and expose candidate block hashes.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.38,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Enhances RPC and REST error/lookup responses so callers can identify pruned transactions and retrieve missing blocks via getblockfrompeer. While useful for downstream integrations, the interface change primarily serves the txindex capability."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only adds feature-specific functional tests for txindex and registers one test in test_runner.py.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Changes test coverage specifically for txindex pruning behavior rather than modifying shared test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The few lines touched in src/init.cpp adjust initialization checks for txindex and prune configuration.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The initialization edits only adapt startup checks for the new txindex behavior, not shared utility or logging infrastructure."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 3,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
